about.headline: Mark & Jake Mahood — Two Generations of Anaheim Craftsmanship
paragraphs: Founded by Mark Mahood in 1980, Mahood's Collision & Hot Rods has spent over four decades repairing daily drivers and painting some of the finest classic cars, Porsches, and street rods in the country.

Mark is an AMBR (America's Most Beautiful Roadster) Award winner who has worked alongside Boyd Coddington, Chip Foose, and Fat Jack. Today, Mark and his son Jake bring that exact same standard of craftsmanship to every collision repair, dent repair, and restoration that enters our Anaheim shop.

reviews.headline: Trusted by Classic Collectors & Daily Drivers Alike

items.name: David Ahlo
items.text: This place is awesome, another awesome job! Color match perfect, wife is happy, we all happy. They build some sick looking classic cars too.

items.name: Jim Irvine
items.text: It only had 56,000 miles on my car and insurance wanted to total the car. Mahood's saved me from the insurance company and new car payments. Bring your car to Mahood's before calling the insurance company!

items.name: Christina Esa
items.text: This shop is the best! I just got my car fixed and it looks BRAND NEW! Mark is the best — I really appreciate all the hard work he and his guys put into my car.

items.name: Saul Magallon
items.text: Had the front end of my Chevy repaired and painted. I just like everything perfect. I was well pleased — $8,000 in repairs and it came out great.
